author: toketrain
body: yesterday's glitch turned one of the avicus lobbies into a vanilla survival world. it was chaotic, but everyone loved it. if there was a more structured survival world (rules, commands, etc.) it could add another element to avicus, more fun and variety and strengthen the community. it could also add more reasons to donate if there were perks. my idea is either another gamemode or a hub that you don't automatically connect to but can with commands or the lobby menu. it would be fun to group up with other players and build a base. all of survival minecraft with the people of avicus. i know this has been suggested before but with that new world being so fun i thought the discussion could be opened again.

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
• Minecraft EULA illegal stuff for servers

  •  Selling non-cosmetic items or pets that affect gameplay
  •  Selling in-game currency used to purchase non-cosmetic items
  •  Having areas of the server accessible only to paying players, including personal land plots
  •  Selling experience or item "boosters" that affect only the purchasing player
  •  Using Minecraft art assets in the server store
  •  Not providing a purchase history or contact details for players regarding purchases
  •  Not including the company or individual that the money is going to, or pretending to be or be affiliated with Mojang

replies.author: toketrain
replies.body:
no ew gross this is not why i made this topic
i want a world where everyone can chill and make groups and friends. strengthening the community is a huge part of this suggestion and making it accessible only to donors is not doing that. people want to be able to group up with all of their friends, not just the ones that can afford to pay.

i really don't like the "UHHH BUT ONLY FOR DONORS RIGHT???" type of stuff that's been coming up on avicus lately tbh. maybe donors should receive a few benefits, but as many have pointed out they should remain cosmetic. as i stated, with my suggestion there would be benefits for donors in this world but not entire exclusion for non-donors. (and i really don't see how restricting it to donors is a benefit for you guys, don't you want to be able to play with cool people that aren't donors?)

replies.author: Petlas
replies.body:
Personally, I think the vanilla world would only turn into a place where kiddies and others alike would get pissed off by griefers, robbers, etc. and waste the time of moderators who'll need to constantly sort out pointless arguments between who the diamonds rightfully belong to and whatnot.

And even if there were plugins installed like regions and essentials to protect your land, I still feel as though its going to take away the civilised aspect of Avicus. And by this, I'm talking about how the survival world would just become a complete mess of spammed blocks, 1x1 towers and minor griefs all over the place, just like most survival worlds on other servers.  If all this happened, it may ruin the server's reputation.
